FIR No. 178/2026 dated 12/08/2026, Sector 17 Police Station.

Complainant Harpreet Kaur reported that her son, Gagandeep Singh, aged 22, has been missing since the evening of 10/08/2026. He was last seen near Sector 22 market, Chandigarh, around 7:30 PM by his friend Manpreet Singh, who stated that Gagandeep received a phone call from an unknown number, 9988112233, and left in a hurry saying he would return shortly.

CCTV footage obtained from a nearby shop shows Gagandeep boarding a white sedan bearing registration number CH03CD7890 at approximately 7:45 PM. Two unidentified men, later described by witness Rohit Bansal as wearing dark clothing, were seen in the vehicle. Rohit also provided a partial description and mentioned overhearing the name "Sonu" being used by one of the men.

On 11/08/2026, the family received a call on Harpreet Kaur's number, 9876554433, demanding a ransom of Rs. 5,00,000 for Gagandeep's safe return. The caller instructed that the amount be transferred to an account and warned against contacting the police. The call was traced to a tower location near Zirakpur, Punjab.

Sub-Inspector Baljit Singh from the Traffic Police assisted in identifying the vehicle's last known movement through toll records. The Punjab Police and the local Crime Branch have been informed and a joint investigation has been initiated. The State Transport Authority was contacted to verify the vehicle's registration details, which showed the vehicle was registered to an address in Ludhiana under the name Balwinder Singh, though it is suspected the vehicle may have been stolen or the registration forged.

A second witness, Neha Kapoor, who runs a tea stall near the market, stated that she recognized one of the men from a previous visit and provided the phone number 9123998877 which she claimed he used to place an order for tea on a separate occasion. This number is being cross-verified against telecom records dated 05/08/2026 through 10/08/2026.

No ransom payment has been made as of the filing of this report. The investigation is ongoing.
